questions.q: In a Group 1 project (e.g., a Hangar), which of the following is NOT included in the Architect's 5% Basic Professional Fee (BPF)?
questions.n: Under SPP Doc 202, technical site data like soil tests and surveys are the responsibility of the Owner to provide.

questions.q: Which of these building types is NOT classified under Group 2 (Moderate Complexity)?
questions.n: Mental Institutions require specialized safety and technical requirements, placing them under Group 3 (Exceptional Complexity).

questions.q: The BPF does NOT cover which of the following project-related costs?
o: Building Permit Fees and LGU charges
questions.n: Government-mandated fees and taxes are external costs paid directly by the Owner to the local government.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a Specialized Architectural Service (and thus is part of the Regular Design Services)?
o: Preparation of the Statement of Probable Construction Cost
questions.n: Cost estimation is a core component of the Regular Design Services (Doc 202), not a specialized add-on like landscaping.

questions.q: If a project is cancelled during the Contract Document Phase, the architect is NOT entitled to:
o: The full 100% of the Basic Professional Fee
questions.n: Upon completion of Contract Documents, the architect is entitled to 85%. The remaining 15% is reserved for the construction phase.

questions.q: The architect is NOT ethically or legally responsible for which of the following regarding the construction?
o: Keeping the client informed of progress
questions.n: An architect is an advisor, not a contractor or a financier. They cannot control market prices or material labor hikes.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an architect’s duty when dealing with the Client’s budget?
o: Advising on materials that meet the budget
Cutting their professional fee to fit the Client's limited budget
questions.n: Reducing fees to underbid others is 'unfair competition' and devalues the entire profession.

questions.q: Regarding project funding, the architect is NOT responsible for:
o: Explaining the sequence of fee payments
Certifying work is ready for payment
Informing the client of estimated costs
Assisting the client in securing bank loans or mortgages
questions.n: Securing financing is a purely financial/business task belonging solely to the Owner.

questions.q: The architect is NOT responsible for the Owner's business success, but they are responsible for:
o: Utility, Strength, and Beauty of the structure
Finding a buyer for the property
questions.n: This reflects the Vitruvian triad (Firmitas, Utilitas, Venustas), which is the core professional mandate.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT part of the Architect's 'Instruments of Service'?
questions.n: The architect owns the intellectual property (drawings); the client owns the physical structure produced from them.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT the architect’s responsibility on the construction site?
o: Ensuring worker safety and safety programs
questions.n: Under Philippine Law, the Contractor is solely liable for site safety and the implementation of safety programs.

questions.q: The architect is NOT responsible for the Contractor’s:
o: Means, methods, and sequences of construction
questions.n: The architect defines 'what' to build; the contractor defines 'how' to build it safely and efficiently.

questions.q: If the Contractor makes an error in field measurements, the architect is NOT liable because:
o: The Contractor is responsible for field verification
The Owner should have measured the lot
questions.n: Contract documents always specify that the contractor must verify all dimensions on-site before commencing work.

questions.q: The architect is NOT responsible for providing the Contractor with:
questions.n: Providing the tools and overhead for construction is the Contractor's contractual obligation.

questions.q: Regarding construction delays, the architect is NOT responsible for:
o: Determining if the cause is valid
Paying for the contractor's losses due to bad weather
questions.n: Force majeure (acts of God) allows for time extensions, but the architect/owner does not reimburse the contractor's financial loss.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an ethical obligation of the architect to their subordinates?
questions.n: A professional license is personal property; its maintenance and fees are the responsibility of the individual professional.

questions.q: An architect is NOT responsible for the work of a subordinate if:
o: The subordinate performs 'moonlighting' work outside office hours
The work was done during office hours
The subordinate is a licensed junior
questions.n: The firm is not liable for unauthorized work done by employees outside of their employment scope and time.

questions.q: It is NOT the architect’s duty to:
o: Sign logbooks for actual hours served
Ensure every intern passes the board exam on the first try
questions.n: The architect provides the opportunity for training; the exam result depends entirely on the intern's effort.

questions.q: The architect is NOT liable for a subordinate's personal legal issues, even if they are:
o: Communicating with a client for the firm
Related to a project in the firm
Errors in drafting missed by the architect
questions.n: Personal legal problems (debt, family issues, etc.) are separate from the firm's professional liability.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a required benefit provided by the architect to the subordinate?
questions.n: While some firms offer these as perks, they are not mandatory legal or ethical requirements.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT part of the 'Contract Documents' according to SPP Doc 301?
o: Contractor's internal Profit and Loss statements
questions.n: A contractor's private financial health is not part of the legal construction contract with the Owner.

questions.q: The architect is NOT responsible for errors caused by Incorrect Property Boundaries if:
o: The data was provided by the Owner's licensed Land Surveyor
The contractor placed the fence wrong
questions.n: Architects are legally allowed to rely on specialized data provided by the client's other consultants.

questions.q: The architect is NOT responsible for 'Latent Defects' because:
o: They are covered by the Contractor’s Guarantee Bond
The architect only visits once a month
questions.n: Latent (hidden) defects are the contractor's liability, backed by a bond, usually for one year after completion.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a status of the Architect at the construction site?
o: The direct Employer of the Contractor's workers
The judge of the work's quality
questions.n: There is no 'privity of contract' between the architect and the workers; they are employed by the Contractor.

questions.q: The architect is NOT responsible for revising plans for free if:
o: Plans were rejected due to architect's errors
The Owner changes the scope after the phase is approved
Structural and architectural plans don't match
There was an error in design
questions.n: Once a design phase is approved, any changes by the owner are 'extra services' and must be paid for.
